prompt: I want to secure our frontend user registration form. Please configure TypoScript settings for `sf-register` to use the recaptcha adapter (`Evoweb\Recaptcha\Adapter\SfRegisterAdapter`) and validate the CAPTCHA during registration. Also, show me how to render the reCAPTCHA in our Fluid registration template.
assertions: Fluid Form template uses {namespace recaptcha=Evoweb\Recaptcha\ViewHelpers} or <recaptcha:render />.
Fluid Form template includes an invisible honeypot field.
